messages:
eli: just merged PR #4867 into main — CI turned red immediately. smoke-gpu step failing. https://ci.redwood/31345
ci-bot: [automated] Pipeline 31345: smoke-gpu step failed (exit code 1). Logs: https://ci.redwood/31345/logs
devops-oncall: oncall grabbing this now. can someone paste the failing snippet?
eli: here are the last lines from the failing job:
```
[2026-03-17 14:12:03] ERROR: test_kv_cache_eviction.py::test_eviction_policy_timeout
AssertionError: Timeout waiting for eviction (120s)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/workspace/tests/test_kv_cache_eviction.py", line 48, in test_eviction_policy_timeout
    wait_for_eviction(120)
  File "/workspace/tests/utils.py", line 12, in wait_for_eviction
    raise AssertionError("Timeout waiting for eviction")
```
tess: hmm that test has been flaky with timeouts before, but usually only on the kvmem nodes. PR 4867 changed a small allocator path though — could be exposing a timing edge.
sam: I can start a quick bisect, but first i'll rerun the smoke job to confirm it's deterministic. rerun queued.
ci-bot: [automated] Rerun of Pipeline 31345 triggered by sam — build 31346 queued.
sam: rerun finished — same test timed out. not a transient fluke.
devops-oncall: can someone reproduce locally on a kvmem test shard? if it's infra we should revert. @tess can you try a local run with the same seed?
tess: running locally now with `PYTEST -k test_kv_cache_eviction -s --dist=loadscope` — reproduces the timeout at ~85s consistently on my dev instance.
eli: thanks. FYI 4867 was touching allocator commit paths but kept behavior identical on paper. if it's reproducing locally maybe it's a logic regression. do we prefer reverting 4867 or bisecting further?
sam: i'll bisect between 4859..4867 to be safe. starting binary search now.
sam: bisect result points at PR 4859 as the first bad commit (surprising, but the change interacts with allocator warmup).
eli: wait 4859 was merged earlier this morning — it adjusted background warmup frequency. that could absolutely affect eviction timing.
devops-oncall: for speed, open a rollback PR for 4859 and hold 4867 open for now. if rollback fixes smoke we'll merge it.
eli: created rollback PR #4890 that reverts 4859, adding ci label `hotfix/revert-4859`. link: https://git.redwood/4890
ci-bot: [automated] Merge of PR 4890 triggered by eli — rolling back 4859. New pipeline 31347 started.
ci-bot: [automated] Pipeline 31347: smoke-gpu step succeeded. :tada:
devops-oncall: smoke green after rollback — closing this incident. we'll follow up with a postmortem and coordinate a safer rework of 4859's warmup frequency. tagging owners: @eli @tess @sam.
eli: thanks all for the quick turnaround. I'll coordinate the postmortem and next steps in #postmortems.
tess: leaving notes to add a targeted regression test around warmup/eviction timing.
sam: filing a follow-up issue for deterministic envs for that test. good job team. :thumbsup:
